exemplars.text:
Describe  how  music  affected  you  in  different  ways  on  two  separate  occasions.  (Remember,  as
well as how it made you feel, you can  describe the music itself and the atmosphere it created.)

Read Paragraph 1, and decide whether each of the following statements is true, false or not stated
in the paragraph and tick the box you have chosen.
TrueFalseNS
Sugar is added to chocolate to take away its bitter flavour.  
Cocoa mass is the same as cocoa butter. 
White chocolate contains no cocoa solids.

Burundi is a country in Sub-Saharan Africa. In 2013 the government of Burundi introduced VAT, an
indirect tax, while lowering corporation tax (the tax on firms’ profits), from 35% to 30%. The United 
Nations  has  encouraged  Sub-Saharan  African  countries  to  increase  their  tax  revenue  in  order  
to  have  more  funds  available  to  spend  on  reducing  poverty.  There  is,  however,  a  debate  about  
whether imposing more taxes or removing some taxes is more beneficial for an economy.

In 2014 Cuban doctors were given pay rises that significantly increased their salaries. This made
doctors’  pay  more  than  twice  that  received  by  nurses.  Cuba  is  devoting  more  resources  to  both  
medical care and tourism, altering the country’s production possibility curve. Living standards are 
increasing in the country but at a slower rate than some other nearby countries.
